title: Report the payments that matched nothing

intent.outcome: The unmatched payments are listed with what was looked for
intent.problem: a payment that matched nothing vanished

acceptance_criteria.description: every unmatched payment has a line
acceptance_criteria.verification: grep -c '"unmatched"' fixtures/gateway.json && echo "the gateway file counts unmatched"

evidence.command: grep -c '"unmatched"' fixtures/gateway.json && echo "the gateway file counts unmatched"

steps.done_when: the report names every unmatched payment

rounds.notes: The report counts unmatched payments instead of naming them.
A payment the gateway never answered has nothing to match.
The gateway's own text is copied into the report.
Measured on a batch with a thousand unmatched payments.
The unmatched line cannot be acted on by finance.

findings.description:
## D1 [high] The unmatched payments are only counted

**where:** `ledgerline-core/src/report.rs`

**defect:** the report prints a count where the task asked for a line per payment.

**scenario:** reconcile a batch with one unmatched payment.

**fix:** write a line naming the payment.
findings.resolution: the report writes a line per unmatched payment

findings.description:
## D1 [high] A payment with no gateway answer disappears

**where:** `ledgerline-core/src/report.rs`

**defect:** a payment the gateway never answered has no entry to match and is skipped.

**scenario:** reconcile a batch where one payment was never sent.

**fix:** write a line saying the gateway has no answer.
findings.resolution: a payment with no gateway answer gets a line of its own

findings.description:
## D1 [high] The gateway's text lands in the report unescaped

**where:** `ledgerline-core/src/report.rs`

**defect:** a newline in the gateway's field splits the report line.

**scenario:** reconcile a batch whose gateway note carries a newline.

**fix:** quote the field before writing it.
findings.resolution: gateway fields are quoted before they reach the report

findings.description:
## D1 [high] A thousand unmatched payments take minutes

**where:** `ledgerline-core/src/report.rs`

**defect:** every report line rescans the whole batch.

**scenario:** reconcile a batch with a thousand unmatched payments.

**fix:** build the index once and read it per line.
findings.resolution: the index is built once; a thousand lines take a second

findings.description:
## D1 [high] The unmatched line does not say what was looked for

**where:** `ledgerline-core/src/report.rs`

**defect:** the line names the payment but not the entry or amount it was matched against.

**scenario:** hand the report to finance and ask why a payment failed.

**fix:** print the reference and amount that were searched for.
